# Lancaster Power Wash Pros

## About
Lancaster Power Wash Pros provides professional power washing and soft washing services for homes and businesses throughout Lancaster County, PA. We use the right cleaning method for each surface — high-pressure where appropriate, soft wash where it is not — with biodegradable solutions that are safe for landscaping and pets.

## Services
- House Washing (exterior soft wash for siding, brick, stucco, and wood)
- Driveway and Concrete Cleaning (oil stains, tire marks, embedded grime)
- Deck and Patio Washing (wood, composite, and concrete — prep for staining or sealing)
- Roof Soft Washing (removes black streaks, moss, and lichen without voiding warranties)
- Fence Washing (wood, vinyl, and aluminum — prep before painting or staining)
- Gutter Brightening (removes oxidation and staining from gutter exteriors)
- Commercial Power Washing (storefronts, parking lots, loading docks, and building exteriors)

## Service Area
Lancaster, Lititz, Ephrata, Manheim, Mount Joy, Elizabethtown, Millersville, Columbia, Strasburg, Quarryville, Lancaster County, PA

## Why Choose Us
Locally owned and operating in Lancaster County for over ten years. We use eco-friendly, biodegradable cleaning solutions on every job. Soft washing is used on roofs and delicate surfaces to avoid damage — we do not apply high pressure where it does not belong. Free estimates with no pressure to book.
